text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ai-san, if the weather's nice tomorrow, do 
you wanna go sunbathe again?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"There's this brown rice tea I've been 
really into lately~. How about some 
between training sessions?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds wonderful! Well then, 
maybe I'll come visit again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that's right, I bought new 
cushions for my room! They're so fluffy 
and comfy... I'll bring those along too."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah~, yay! A cushion and the warm sun... 
It's the ultimate combo! So cozy and 
fluffy...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true... Leaning back to sip 
some tea, stretching out and relaxing...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Sunbathing together like this has 
really become a routine for us, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right... I started it... and I've kept it 
up. Still...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I really love this. Basking in the sun 
with you, Craft-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
During recess or training breaks... It's 
only a short time, but... being with you 
always puts me at ease.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? ...Ehehe. If it makes Ai-san 
feel nice and cozy, that makes me happy 
too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I hope the weather's nice tomorrow. Right, 
Eye-san!
